label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
To: #jobs
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Desert Palms codes and tray

Marco, I'm pissed. You told me Saturday Desert Palms was done, 14 units, all good, keys dropped with Yvette. It wasn't done. Not one code is in the sheet.

Lupe told me this morning the tenant in 9B lost her key and Yvette needs three copies today. Now we have nothing to cut from. That's a customer waiting on us because you left part of the job undone. Dropping off the keys doesn't finish a rekey. Recording the codes is part of the work.

I told everybody August 4: every rekey, every master job, codes in the sheet SAME DAY, before you leave the van. Address, unit, code. No exceptions. Then I had to tell you again on the Kessler job in September. We're not going to keep having the same conversation.

You're going back to Desert Palms today. Coordinate access with Yvette and decode 9B first so we can get those three keys cut today. Get that code into the sheet as soon as you have it. Decode all 14 units if you can get access, and record each one against the right unit. If you can't get into every unit, tell me exactly which ones are still missing and what it'll take to finish. Don't leave me guessing.

And pick up my black pinning tray from the leasing office, pins and all. Shop tools don't get left on a customer's counter.

You're good with your hands, Marco. I want you here doing good work. But I need to be able to trust that when you say a job is done, it's done, including the records and bringing our equipment home.

Let me know here when you're headed out, when 9B is recorded, and where we stand on the other 13 before you finish today. This can't keep happening.
